test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Being seen the film__ once he doesn’t want to see it again.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Having seen the film**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In the above-given sentence, '**Being seen the film**' will be replaced by ‘Having seen the film’.
 
• As per the general rule, **perfect participle clauses** show that **the action they describe was finished before the action in the main clause**.
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• ***Having lived in London**, I know its climate very well. (correct)*
 
• ***Being lived in London**, I know its climate very well. (incorrect)*
 
 
 
• Here, in the given above sentence, '**Being seen the film**' is used as a perfect participle clause, which is wrong according to the rule.
 
• According to the explanation and example that are given above, ‘Having seen the film’ is the most appropriate substitute to the underlined segment.

 

**Correct sentence:** *Having seen the film once he doesn’t want to see it again.*
